blessing.description: A hero with a Blessing contributes +1 to their Role or Faction Synergy.

shop_interest.description: Hold 10-50 gold to earn interest each round. Typical level pacing: level 4 by round 6, level 5 by round 9, level 6 by round 13, level 7 by round 17, levels 8/9 around round 21+. Shop Lock preserves the current shop heroes for the next round.

fate_box.description: An extra board slot can be obtained from the Fate Box (Go Go Box).

board_capacity.description: Commander level determines deployable heroes: level 3 -> 3, 4 -> 4, 5 -> 5, 6 -> 6, 7 -> 7, 8 -> 8, 9 -> 9.
board_capacity.source: Provided by requester; standard MCGG capacity rules

choice_magic_crystal.description: Season 7 introduced an upgraded Choice Magic Crystal system. Example: assign a Choice Magic Crystal to Kishin to activate the 6-Kishin synergy. Full selection mechanics unconfirmed.
choice_magic_crystal.source: Official Moonton S7 announcement (en.moonton.com/news/364.html); Kishin comp guide

new_s7_synergies.description: Season 7 added Echomancer (summons a random 5-cost hero from a past season), SPECTRE (can unlock Alpha, MCGG's first 7-gold hero), Starbelle (Lightstick turns a hero into a Fan), and Mistbender (gathers tokens during battle to spend in a special shop). Dragon Altar and Shadeweaver returned.

comps.name: 6 Kishin 3 Phasewarper 3 Shadeweaver
comps.early_game: Economy commander (Kalea, Guinevere, or Popol and Kupa). Early game: run Echomancer, Scavenger, and Phasewarper units while leveling to 9, then transition. Assign a Choice Magic Crystal to Kishin to activate 6 Kishin. Add Hylos for 3 Shadeweaver if a Fate Box slot or level 10 allows; if the Chrono Wanderer is Gatotkaca, replace Angela with Dyrroth.
comps.notes: From a current S7 Kishin comp guide. Carry hero and item sets not specified in the source, so they are left empty rather than invented.

comps.name: 6 Stargazer 3 Necrokeep
comps.early_game: Prioritize the Stargazer Magic Crystal and EXP cards to hit power spikes early.
comps.notes: From MTE's MCGG synergy/lineup guide. Predates Season 7.1; viability in the current patch is unconfirmed. Tank: Leomord with Demon Hunter Sword, Haas' Claws, Golden Staff.

comps.name: 6 Dragon Altar 4 Swordsman
comps.early_game: Take Inspire early for attack speed while building the Dragon Altar core.
comps.notes: From MTE's MCGG synergy/lineup guide. Predates Season 7.1; viability in the current patch is unconfirmed. Tank: Sun Wukong with Dominance Ice, Immortality, Oracle.

comps.name: Echomancer + Scavenger
comps.early_game: Strong Scavenger early game for economy and tempo; scales into a strong late game once a 3-star hero is online.
comps.notes: From current S7 creator videos (top-global style Echomancer + Scavenger games). Exact hero board and item sets not specified in the source.

comps.name: Bruiser + Dragon Altar
comps.early_game: Open with Echomancer units early, then pivot into the Bruiser + Dragon Altar core.
comps.notes: From current S7 creator videos. Exact hero board and item sets not specified.

comps.name: Dragoncaller + Dragon Altar
comps.early_game: Use Scavenger for a strong early game, then scale into the Dragoncaller + Dragon Altar late-game combo once a 3-star hero is online.
comps.notes: From current S7 creator videos (Kalea commander). Exact hero board and item sets not specified.

comps.name: Shadeweaver + Starbelle
comps.early_game: Use Scavenger early for economy while assembling the Shadeweaver + Starbelle core.
comps.notes: From current S7 creator videos (Chou commander). Exact hero board and item sets not specified.

comps.name: Starbelle + Scavenger
comps.early_game: Scavenger start for economy; transition into the Starbelle core.
comps.notes: From current S7 creator videos (Luo Yi commander). Exact hero board and item sets not specified.

comps.name: 6 Bruiser 2 Weapon Master (Racikan 🧪)
comps.early_game: Early: Dyrroth + Belerick + Martis, hemat gold, jangan roll. Mid (lv 6-7): lengkapkan 4 Bruiser, cari Bintang 2. Late (lv 8): 6 Bruiser + 2 Weapon Master; Bintang 3-kan hero murah (Dyrroth, Belerick, Paquito). Item attack speed + lifesteal ke Badang/Yin, item tank (Dominance Ice, Immortality) ke Belerick/Aldous. Posisi: gerombol di tengah, adu pukul.
comps.notes: Racikan Jewel: comp full-melee out-of-the-box. Bruiser proc double-strike + lifesteal satu tim = sustain adu pukul. Sepi kontes hero = gampang Bintang 3. Belum teruji di rank, coba di casual dulu.

comps.name: 4 Dauntless 2 Marksman 2 Mage (Racikan 🧪)
comps.early_game: Hemat early, roll di lv 7-8 untuk Bintang 2 semua. Item tank ke Lolita/Hilda; item attack speed ke Miya/Wanwan, item magic ke Zhuxin/Kadita. Tidak ada single carry — damage tersebar fisik + magic sehingga tidak ada satu counter keras.
comps.notes: Racikan Jewel: fondasi anti-counter (jack-of-all-trades). Kuat lawan semua, tidak seledak comp 6-piece fokus. Belum teruji di rank, coba di casual dulu.
